content.short: Race, fight and explore Wiami, a Miami-inspired city in Wilder World's Unreal Engine 5 open world, free on the Epic Games Store.
content.description: Wilder World blends street racing, shooter combat and RPG missions in a photorealistic city called Wiami. Players choose a hero role, explore the open world and own their vehicles, land and avatars as NFTs. The WILD token powers the in-game economy, staking and DAO governance across Ethereum, Polygon and Base. The game is free to download on the Epic Games Store. Wiami has neighbourhoods, business districts, factories and famous landmarks to explore, and items can be bought in the game's market and store, with early access open to new players.
content.meta: Free Unreal Engine 5 open-world game set in Wiami, with owned vehicles, land and avatars. Explore Wilder World on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
